# Timebroker.ai

> Timebroker.ai connects the best fractional Chief AI Officers (CAIOs) with the companies that need them. We design custom AI built around how your business actually works, automating the manual work that eats your week — so you get your time back. Veterans and small businesses are our focus, and non-profits receive 50% discounted rates.

## Core idea
Time is money. If that is true, investing in getting more of it back is the best investment you can make. Timebroker.ai delivers that through custom AI tailored to each business.

## Founder
Delray Peter Wannemacher — Founder, Chairman & CEO of Edge Data Solutions (OTC: EDGS), an SEC-reporting digital-infrastructure company whose immersion-cooling datacenter he engineered and deployed from the ground up; he personally signed the Sarbanes-Oxley officer certifications. Founder of First Look Equities (2015). Executive Board Member and VP of Business Development at the World Trade Center Atlanta, and Vice-Chair of Corporate Partnerships for World Trade Day.

## Services
- Fractional CAIO engagement — senior AI leadership, part-time: audit, design, implement, govern.
- Custom AI build — AI designed around your specific business and workflows.
- Free AI audit — a complimentary gap assessment of your website plus a 15-minute strategic briefing.

## Who we serve
- Veteran-owned businesses (primary focus)
- Small businesses (primary focus)
- Non-profit organizations (50% discounted rates)
- Founder-led and mid-market companies
